paraphrase: In the last canto, Cīvakaṉ, having ruled, is moved by the sight of a forest-keeper snatching a jackfruit from a monkey to see kingship as seizure; he gives the kingdom to his son, goes to Mahāvīra's assembly, takes initiation, and after austerities attains release; his queens become nuns.
notes: Canto 13 (Mukti ilampakam); the jackfruit episode recalled with low confidence.
